# Getting help

English | [简体中文](https://github.com/shenjiecode/pi-wechat-assistant/blob/main/.github/SUPPORT.zh.md)

- New user: follow the [hands-on tutorial](https://github.com/shenjiecode/pi-wechat-assistant/blob/main/docs/tutorial.md).
- Something stopped working: start with the [FAQ](https://github.com/shenjiecode/pi-wechat-assistant/blob/main/docs/faq.md).
- Still stuck: [open an issue](https://github.com/shenjiecode/pi-wechat-assistant/issues/new/choose), describing what you tried, what happened, and your extension/Pi/Node versions. Mention TUI versus headless use and whether another Pi session is open.
- Sensitive issue: use [private reporting](https://github.com/shenjiecode/pi-wechat-assistant/security/advisories/new).

This is a community project maintained in spare time; replies are not guaranteed within a fixed time. Be respectful, keep one problem per report, and avoid posting the same request repeatedly. You may use any language. When sharing diagnostics, include only the relevant sanitized lines, not the entire state directory or chat history.
